name: list_user_events
description:
Retrieves a list of "events" generated by the User on Vercel. Events are generated when the User performs a particular action, such as logging in, creating a deployment, and joining a Team (just to name a few). When the `teamId` parameter is supplied, then the events that are returned will be in relation to the Team that was specified.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v3/events --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

entityId.description: Filters events to those associated with a specific entity (matched against `payload.id`). For example, a connector ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of items which may be returned.

principalId.description: When retrieving events for a Team, the `principalId` parameter may be specified to filter events generated by a specific principal.

projectIds.description: Comma-delimited list of project IDs to filter the results by.

since.description: Timestamp to only include items created since then.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

types.description: Comma-delimited list of event "types" to filter the results by.

until.description: Timestamp to only include items created until then.

userId.description: Deprecated. Use `principalId` instead. If `principalId` and `userId` both exist, `principalId` will be used.

withPayload.description: When set to `true`, the response will include the `payload` field for each event.
